description: Find current or former Swiss Parliament affiliation records by name, council, canton, party, or parliamentary group. membership defaults to current; former selects inactive records and all omits the activity filter. query matches a substring of a published first, last, or official name. Use each record’s personNumber with chparl_get_member for identity, full council terms, committees, and declared interests. Follow nextOffset with the same filters.

cantonId.description: Optional Canton identifier from chparl_list_reference topic cantons.

council.description: N or S; exact German, French, and Italian council names are accepted. Resolve codes with chparl_list_reference topic councils.

groupId.description: Optional ParlGroupNumber from chparl_list_reference topic groups.

language.description: Metadata language: de (default), fr, or it; uppercase is accepted.

limit.description: Requested page size, default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice. Whole records may be fitted to the response byte budget.

membership.description: current (default), former, or all MemberCouncil records.

offset.description: Starting MemberCouncil record offset; continue with returned nextOffset.

partyId.description: Optional Party identifier from chparl_list_reference topic parties.

query.description: Optional name substring, trimmed without changing internal punctuation or diacritics.

name: chparl_search_members

limit.description: Effective requested record count after clamping.

membership.description: current filters Active true; former false; all omits Active.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective requested page size after clamping.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: Whether further matching affiliation records remain.

members.description: Complete MemberCouncil affiliation records delivered on this page.

active.description: Published activity flag; absent means unknown.

groupAbbreviation.description: Published parliamentary-group abbreviation for this record.

groupId.description: Published parliamentary-group identifier for this record.

groupName.description: Published parliamentary-group name for this record.

joinedDate.description: Council term joining date, without an inferred timezone.

leftDate.description: Council term leaving date, when published.

metadataLanguage.description: Selected metadata row language, not a translation claim.

partyAbbreviation.description: Published party abbreviation for this record.

partyId.description: Published party identifier for this record.

partyName.description: Published party name for this record.

personNumber.description: PersonNumber used by every member-profile lookup.

sourceUrl.description: HTTPS OData URL for this exact source record.

notice.description: Combined clamping, byte fitting, empty-result, or past-end guidance.
